entities.name: Merrik Aidar
entities.description: Benalish patrol member who complains about polearms.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: Speaker who advises never letting enemies take their eyes off you.

entities.description: Planeswalker who says he has no time for you right now.

entities.name: Cyla
entities.description: Lord of the Aerie, who comments on an eyekite.

entities.name: Veldka
entities.description: Wandering sage.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: Femeref philosopher.

entities.name: Benden
entities.description: Teahouse gossip who doubts ninja tales.

entities.name: Ghoulcaller Gisa
entities.description: Necromancer who shoos crypt rats from her corpses.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: Necromancer who writes to Gisa about theft from his laboratory.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker who says 'At last, silence.'

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Planeswalker who advises giving foes a choice when they have none.

entities.name: Zaz
entities.description: Freshly promoted 'first rock' of a sling-gang.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Mage who calls fire his most faithful companion.

entities.name: Rukarumel
entities.description: Scholar whose field journal studies the hollowhead sliver.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: Planeswalker who says small outbursts are healthy.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Leader who vows to finish what the villages of Kjeldor started.

entities.name: Norin the Wary
entities.description: Fearful man who hates fire.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who describes the calls of a bellowing elk.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Artificer who speaks of the collector ouphe.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya dryad who urges planting every sword.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Speaker of the warning about the Altar of Dementia.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Character who likens herself to the rising sun.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker who talks about good ideas.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Planeswalker who speaks of exploring.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who speaks of hierarchy.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who speaks of the rise of the downtrodden.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Scholar whose journal records a strange device.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Leader whose summons set aside tribal rivalries.

entities.name: Worzel
entities.description: Summoner of Segovian angels against Thomil's gnats.

entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: Owner of the Gargantikari gnats.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel before whose divine might craven beasts once cowered.

entities.name: Ayula
entities.description: Bear queen born from the oldest red cedar who marks her territories with runic clawmarks.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: Anurid whose spawn ruled long after he croaked.

entities.name: Kess
entities.description: Mage who says loss has no meaning.

entities.name: Umezawa
entities.description: Namesake of a charm that urges loyalty to your own interests.

entities.name: The First Sliver
entities.description: Origin of the sliver hive, guarded by its tenacious members and able to call back the dead.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: Entity with which all sounds harmonize.

entities.name: Silverblade
entities.description: Order whose motto is 'Where divinity leads, victory follows.'

entities.name: Gargantikari
entities.description: Gnats owned by Thomil that fought Worzel's angels.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Region whose villages burn in retaliation.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: Forest that remembers the Ice Age, the Phyrexian Invasion and the Rift Era.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Place where relics of the Time of Ice slumber.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane with the stronghold of Heliod's light.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire whose priests dug a well and tapped something else.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Disaster that Llanowar remembers.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Disaster remembered by Llanowar; its relics slumber in New Argive.

entities.name: Rift Era
entities.description: Disaster remembered by Llanowar.

events.summary: Worzel summons Segovian angels against Thomil's gnats in one of the Multiverse's least destructive battles.
events.quote: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

events.summary: Eladamri's summons causes tribes to lay aside their rivalries.
events.quote: Tribal rivalries and petty disputes were laid aside at Eladamri's summons.

events.summary: Sun Empire priests tap something unexpected while digging a well.
events.quote: Sun Empire priests thought they were digging a well.

relations.note: Rem Karolus is called Blade of the Inquisitors; the Silverblade motto appears alongside.
relations.quote: "What cannot be destroyed will be bound, but do try to destroy it the first time."
When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

relations.note: Geralf writes a letter to Gisa accusing someone of stealing from his laboratory.
relations.quote: "I think someone is stealing from my laboratory. It had better not be you!"
